title: edgePass config
description: config.json / config.yaml as edgePass reads it. Everything here is data: the header LEDs (toggles[]), the owner's services (services[]) and the MCP servers (mcpServers[]) are edited from the widget, from a file, or over the pipe — never by changing the binary.

baoAddr.description: OpenBao / Vault address. Loopback only: edgePass refuses to talk to a remote vault.

namespaces.description: Vault namespaces, in the order the panel lists them. "" = root.

autoSealIdleSecs.description: Seal the vault after this many idle seconds. 0 = never (sealing cuts every client).

autoCollapseIdleSecs.description: Collapse the expanded panel after this many seconds without the pointer. 0 = never.

initPath.description: Path to the vault init file (unseal keys + token). Empty = not configured.

qringPack.description: Q-ring pack directory. Empty = integration off.

toggles.description: The header LEDs, in order. Each one names a probe (how it reads state) and up to three actions. A fresh install ships only KV (OpenBao is a prerequisite).

services.description: Owner-defined services. Each row publishes the probe svc.<id> and the actions svc.<id>.on / svc.<id>.off, so a toggle can watch it without the exe knowing about it.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers edgePass starts, watches and restarts. Each row also publishes mcp.<id>; the aggregate is mcp.servers.

passphrase.description: The suggested-passphrase style. `randomChars` is fresh entropy per phrase; `installSalt` (below) only diversifies across machines.

installSalt.description: Per-installation hex salt mixed into the passphrase draw. Not a secret and not extra entropy: it only diversifies across machines cloned from the same snapshot. Generated on the first passphrase.

id.description: Stable key (derived from the label when empty). What a click and {"op":"toggle"} send.

label.description: What the LED says (KV, GW, GOV…). Four characters is the pill's budget.

probe.description: Built-in probe (vault.seal, qring.process, mcp.servers…), a derived svc.<id>, or a derived mcp.<id>. Read the live list from {"op":"toggles"} → catalog.probes.

on.description: Action when the probe says off. Empty = this side does nothing (read-only light).

off.description: Action when the probe says on. Empty = this side does nothing.

alt.description: Optional third action for Ctrl / right click.

id.description: Stable key; slugged by the backend. The probe is svc.<id>.

label.description: Short name for the panel. Defaults to the id.

image.description: Image to look for (mi-api.exe). Runs nothing.

match.description: Optional argument substring, to tell apart processes that share an interpreter.

cmd.description: Command to run. Exit code is the contract: 0 = on, 2 = off, 3 = warn. First stdout line = tooltip.

secretEnv.description: Credentials read from OpenBao at spawn time and put only in the child's environment.
